notes: Only the deductible and the premium differ across the four Copay PPO plans. Every copay, the $9,200 out-of-pocket maximum, preventive care and the prescription schedule are IDENTICAL.

Because preventive care and generic maintenance drugs are $0 with no deductible on all four, a client who only uses those two things should take the HIGHEST deductible — it is the cheapest premium for the same practical outcome.
Benefit schedule read from the four PHCS SBCs, rates effective 1 January 2026. Filed at Optimum Carrier Library/LifeX/Copay PPO/.
VL, MM, MM Plus and HSA families are priced in tool/rates/lifex-rates.json but their benefit schedules are NOT yet held — only the Copay PPO SBCs are in hand.
